method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Record chip rally adds $2 trillion in combined value to Micron, Intel and AMD in second quarter
Equities.summary: Wall Street poured into chipmakers not named Nvidia in the second quarter, as the artificial intelligence boom expanded to include more suppliers.
Equities.reason: Strong, broad AI-driven chip rally represents a dominant equity-market leadership theme (tech/semis) and is market-positive for risk appetite and cyclical tech exposure.

Equities.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq register best quarter since 2020 despite Iran war
Equities.reason: Broad-market data showing strongest quarter since 2020 underpins a risk-on regime and validates tech-led gains as the dominant narrative, despite geopolitical noise.

Equities.title: S&P 500: Tech-led gains support equities – Deutsche Bank
Equities.summary: Deutsche Bank’s Jim Reid and team note that the S&P 500 ended Q2 strongly, with the index up 0.79% on the day and delivering its best quarter since Q2 2020.
Equities.reason: Analyst note emphasizing tech leadership reinforces the prevailing positive equity regime and momentum into quarter-end.

Equities.title: Palo Alto, CrowdStrike both have best quarter ever as AI threats bolster cyber demand
Equities.summary: The cybersecurity leaders are leaning into identity security, a critical cyber segment, as AI agents outnumber humans
Equities.reason: Sector-specific evidence of AI driving strong earnings and demand in cybersecurity supports the broader tech/AI leadership narrative; medium relevance as it is industry-level, not market-wide.

Equities.title: Debt and Risky Bets Fuel South Korea and Taiwan's AI Stock Boom
Equities.reason: Highlights leverage and speculative positioning behind the regional AI rally — a meaningful fragility/risk-off signal that could amplify drawdowns if sentiment reverses.

Rates.title: Australian Dollar underperforms as rallying US Treasury Yields prompt risk-off mood
Rates.summary: The Australian Dollar (AUD) is down against its major currency peers, trading 0.45% lower to near 0.6890 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Wednesday.
Rates.reason: Links AUD weakness directly to a rally in US Treasury yields — clear signal of bond sell-off / higher-for-longer yield impulse. FX story but explicitly driven by US yields, so medium-high relevance for Rates.

Rates.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Extends rally to near 162.70 amid soaring US bond yields
Rates.summary: The USD/JPY pair trades 0.1% higher to near 162.73 during the European trading session on Wednesday. The pair reflects strength as surging United States (US) Treasury Yields have strengthened the US Dollar (USD).
Rates.reason: Direct, explicit linkage between USD/JPY move and 'soaring US bond yields' — strong, high-signal confirmation of higher US yields / bond sell-off. High relevance for Rates.

Rates.title: Indian Rupee drops amid surging US Treasury Yields, US data awaited
Rates.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens lower against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday. The USD/INR pair rises to near 94.72 as stronger United States (US) Treasury Yields and higher US Dollar have diminished the appeal of risk-sensitive currencies.
Rates.reason: Currency move attributed to surging US Treasury yields; supports the cross-market narrative of rising US yields and risk-off. Relevant to global Rates as evidence of yield-driven FX flows.

Rates.title: Japan spent $74 billion propping up the yen. Investors say the real battle is with the Fed
Rates.summary: Yen intervention alone is unlikely to reverse losses while wide U.S.-Japan rate differentials keep supporting the dollar, said analysts.
Rates.reason: Confirms that large U.S.-Japan yield differentials are a dominant driver — reinforces higher-for-longer US yields narrative and pressure on bond markets. High relevance to Rates given scale of intervention and cross-border rate differentials.

Rates.title: Foreign Buying of Indian Bonds Hits Record After Tax Break
Rates.reason: Record foreign demand for Indian bonds implies local bond inflows that can compress Indian yields — a localized positive for bond prices. Lower relevance to the dominant US Treasury-driven global rates narrative, so scored modestly.

FX.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Weakens to near 1.1400 as ECB hike bets recede, bearish vibe prevails
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair trades on a negative note near 1.1410 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. Cooling inflation in Germany has lowered expectations for the European Central Bank (ECB) rate hikes, weighing on the Euro (EUR) against the US Dollar
FX.reason: EUR weakening narrative: cooler German inflation and receding ECB hike bets are directly bearish for EUR/USD, consistent with broader USD support.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index strengthens above 101.00 as traders ramp up bets on Fed rate hike
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), an index of the value of the US Dollar (USD) measured against a basket of six world currencies, currently trades near 101.30 in the early European trading hours on Wednesday.
FX.reason: Broad USD strength (DXY >101) driven by Fed-hike bets is a major cross-market driver, pressuring EUR/GBP/AUD/CAD/JPY and reinforcing a USD-dominant regime.

FX.title: ECB’s Cipollone urged colleagues to hold off on further hikes until new economic projections land
FX.summary: European Central Bank (ECB) Executive Board member Piero Cipollone on Wednesday urged colleagues to hold off on any further rate hikes until new economic projections land.
FX.reason: Dovish/timing caution from an ECB Executive Board member reduces odds of further ECB tightening—negative for EUR vs USD and supports the prevailing USD strength narrative.

FX.title: ECB's Demarco: Central bank can delay decision on additional tightening until next projections
FX.summary: European Central Bank (ECB) Governing Council member and Governor of the Central Bank of Malta, Alexander Demarco, said on Wednesday that the central bank can delay decisions on additional tightening until next projections.
FX.reason: Additional ECB comments endorsing a delay on tightening add to downside pressure on the euro versus a firmer dollar; useful corroborating signal but less idiosyncratic than flash USD moves.

FX.title: Japanese Yen sinks to fresh low since 1986 vs USD amid persistently wide US-Japan rate gap
FX.summary: The USD/JPY pair builds on the previous day's breakout momentum and continues to scale new multi-decade highs through the Asian session on Wednesday.
FX.reason: Major JPY weakness vs USD (multi-decade lows) reflects the dominant USD-rate differential story and is market-moving for FX and cross-asset flows (carry, equities, bonds).

FX.title: Japan’s Mimura says past Japanese Yen intervention demonstrated effect
FX.summary: Atsushi Mimura, Japan’s Vice Finance Minister for International Affairs and top foreign exchange official, said that intervention to prop up the yen two months ago was successful, and some US authorities voiced support, Bloomberg reported on Wednesday.
FX.reason: Confirms effectiveness/precedent of FX intervention — a meaningful counter-signal that can limit further JPY depreciation and occasionally trigger one-off flows; treated as a lower-relevance mitigant to the USD-strength trend.

FX.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Rebounds toward nearly 15-month highs, 1.4250
FX.summary: USD/CAD posts gains after registering minor losses in the previous day, trading around 1.4210 during the European hours on Wednesday. The pair is positioned close to nearly 15-month highs.
FX.reason: USD/CAD rally toward multi-month highs aligns with broad USD strength and safe‑haven/geopolitical flows; relevant for CAD given commodity exposure but mainly reinforces USD-dominant narrative.

FX.title: Australian Dollar remains depressed below 0.6900 vs firmer USD after China's PMI
FX.summary: The AUD/USD pair struggles to capitalize on the previous day's goodish rebound from the 0.6865 region, or a three-month low, and meets with a fresh supply during the Asian session on Wednesday.
FX.reason: AUD underperforming vs a firmer USD following China PMI — a regional demand/data-driven USD-support signal with moderate relevance to FX risk sentiment.

FX.title: Yuan Rally Bets Fade as Options Traders Turn Bullish on Dollar
FX.reason: Options-flow and positioning indicate rising USD bullishness at the margin versus CNH/CNY — reinforces a broad USD-strong/EMFX-pressured regime and is relevant for EM FX cross-market transmission.

Commodities.title: Gold Steadies as US-Iran Peace Talks Frame Inflation Outlook
Commodities.reason: Gold reacting to geopolitical easing (US-Iran talks) which can reduce inflation/flight-to-safety premium; headline implies stabilization but underlying tone is modestly bearish for bullion given lower risk premium.

Commodities.title: North Sea oil and renewables: The UK’s next PM faces a defining energy policy decision
Commodities.summary: Andy Burnham could face an early test over North Sea oil drilling as energy shocks revive the UK energy security debate.
Commodities.reason: Potential push to expand North Sea drilling points to increased future supply and energy-security-driven production plans — modestly negative for oil prices, but UK-specific and medium relevance.

Commodities.title: UAE's exit from OPEC+ reduced the group's share of crude oil production and capacity
Commodities.summary: On April 28, 2026, the United Arab Emirates (UAE) announced that it was leaving OPEC, effective on May 1. OPEC was formed in 1960 by Iraq, Iran, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, and Venezuela, with the stated objective to "coordinate and unify petroleum policies among Me
Commodities.reason: Structural change to OPEC+ membership reduces the group's share/capacity and could weaken coordinated supply management — a medium-to-high relevance structural bearish factor for crude market discipline and price.

Commodities.title: Gold remains depressed below $4,000; eyes YTD low ahead of Fed Chair Warsh's speech
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) maintains its offered tone for the third straight day and trades below the $4,000 psychological mark heading into the European session on Wednesday. The precious metal remains well within striking distance of its lowest level since November 2025
Commodities.reason: Clear price weakness driven by stronger USD and Fed-hike expectations; direct market-moving short-term bearish signal for bullion with above-average relevance.

Commodities.title: WTI holds losses near $69.50 amid US-Iran Doha talks
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price remains subdued for the second successive day, trading around $69.70 per barrel during the Asian hours on Wednesday. Crude oil prices decline as supply concerns ease amid potential peace talks in Doha between the US and
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical de‑risking (Doha talks) easing supply concerns, producing a clear short-term oil price decline — high relevance given direct price link to WTI levels.

Commodities.title: Goldman Flags Up Oil Surplus Even as Nations Rebuild Stockpiles
Commodities.reason: Major bank analysis highlighting an oil surplus despite stockpile rebuilding is a significant bearish fundamental signal for crude — high relevance for market positioning and forward price expectations.

Commodities.title: U.S. commercial crude oil inventories have decreased in June
Commodities.summary: For the week ending June 19, 2026, U.S. refineries processed 17.1 million barrels per day (b/d) of crude oil, down 81,000 b/d from the previous week, and they operated at 96.1% capacity utilization. Gasoline production averaged 9.5 million b/d, and distillate
Commodities.reason: Reported decline in U.S. commercial crude inventories is supportive for oil prices — a direct supply-demand datapoint that offsets some bearish geopolitical easing.

Commodities.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
Commodities.summary: Gold prices fell in India on Wednesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.
Commodities.reason: Local price print confirming downward momentum in bullion markets; useful corroboration of broader bearish gold trend, moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD declines below $58 amid uncertainty over US-Iran peace prospects
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) trades almost 1% lower, slightly below $58.00, during the Asian trading session on Wednesday.
Commodities.reason: Silver following gold lower as geopolitical de‑risking and USD strength weigh on precious metals; direct short-term bearish signal for silver prices.

Commodities.title: Oil ticks higher as Iran's refusal to meet US envoys dims ceasefire hopes
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical setback (Iran refusing to meet) raises supply-risk premium and bids oil up — a clear short-term bullish catalyst with material market relevance.

Commodities.title: Oil Steadies as Peace Talks, Flows Through Hormuz in Focus
Commodities.reason: Headline emphasizes balance between peace-talk optimism and physical flows through Hormuz; overall tone leans to easing risk and steadier/lower oil — medium-high relevance.

Commodities.title: Oil posts largest quarterly drop in 6 years as historic supply crunch eases
Commodities.reason: Quarterly price decline driven by easing supply crunch is a significant bearish macro signal for oil markets and market positioning — notable relevance for near-term direction.

Commodities.title: U.S. refining capacity decreased during 2025
Commodities.summary: U.S. operable atmospheric distillation capacity, the primary measure of refinery capacity, totaled 18.2 million barrels per calendar day (b/cd) on January 1, 2026-down over 250,000 b/cd (about 1%) compared with January 1, 2025-according to our latest annual Re
Commodities.reason: Decline in refining capacity can tighten product balances and support refined product/pricing, indirectly supportive for crude; moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: Iran says it is selling oil at 20% premium as end of U.S. blockade sees 40 million barrels exported
Commodities.summary: The ceasefire prompted a surge in crude shipments through the Strait of Hormuz, where traffic had largely ground to a halt during the conflict.
Commodities.reason: Surge in Iranian exports increases global supply; selling at a premium indicates market absorption but net effect is additional barrels hitting markets — bearish for prices with above-average relevance.

Crypto.reason: Product-level integration that combines stablecoin yield and spend in a major wallet (MetaMask) improves on‑chain stablecoin utility and retail adoption — modestly positive for crypto demand and on‑ramp flows.

Crypto.reason: Regulatory review that could enable broader ETF structures is material for institutional flows into crypto products — a meaningful positive for market access and demand if it loosens constraints.

Crypto.title: Tokenized securities need competition, not gatekeepers
Crypto.reason: Opinion piece arguing for competitive tokenization markets supports a pro‑innovation narrative; relevant to on‑chain securities debate but lower direct market impact than regulatory or flow news.

Crypto.reason: Enforcement action against a fraudulent platform supports market integrity and long‑term trust, but the headline is small in dollar terms and limited immediate market impact.

Crypto.reason: Single‑asset technical/flows item: improved network activity and deleveraging supporting XRP price — limited but positive signal for that token's market microstructure.

Crypto.title: Taiwan’s sweeping crypto law raises the bar with licensing, reserve mandates, and tough penalties

Crypto.title: Jefferies warns of crypto market volatility as Clarity Act faces Senate test
Crypto.reason: Analyst warning tied to pending legislation raises the risk of heightened volatility around regulatory outcomes — a near‑term negative for sentiment and flows.

Crypto.title: Phantom doubles down on perpetual futures with hire of Hyperliquid market builders
Crypto.reason: Exchange/venue investment in perp futures liquidity provision improves derivatives market depth and tradability — modestly positive for market structure and flow.

Crypto.title: Circle craters 17% as Stripe, Coinbase and BlackRock back rival stablecoin network
Crypto.reason: Major participants backing a rival stablecoin network and a sharp drawdown in Circle equity/market cap is a significant negative for incumbent stablecoin (USDC) confidence and could disrupt stablecoin flows — high relevance and negative.

Crypto.title: Nasdaq expands distribution of its market data into blockchain infrastructure
Crypto.reason: Major market‑data provider extending distribution into blockchain infrastructure signals institutional integration and data‑feed support for on‑chain markets — a clear positive for adoption and infrastructure.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin’s quiet $59,000-$60,000 range is starting to look dangerous
Crypto.reason: Technical consolidation at a key level combined with risk of breakdown increases downside risk for BTC — negative for near‑term sentiment and leverage positioning.

Crypto.title: New York Life's $800 billion asset manager makes tokenization debut with Centrifuge fund
Crypto.reason: Large traditional asset manager launching an on‑chain tokenized fund is a meaningful institutional adoption signal that supports long‑term demand and legitimization of tokenization.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin $4.4 billion supply overhang emerges as institutional demand wilts
Crypto.reason: Notable institutional outflow / supply overhang is a material negative for BTC price dynamics — significant relevance to spot and ETF demand.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin nears 2024 lows as options traders pay up for downside protection
Crypto.reason: Derivatives market data showing elevated demand for downside protection indicates risk‑off hedging and negative sentiment for BTC — meaningful near‑term bearish signal.

Crypto.title: Strategy heads for 11th losing month in 12 as bitcoin weakness continues
Crypto.reason: Persistent multi‑month underperformance in a major crypto strategy signals continued weakness in BTC-related returns and investor appetite — negative for overall crypto sentiment.

Crypto.title: UK to lower stablecoin capital buffers, undercutting EU's MiCA requirements
Crypto.reason: UK easing of stablecoin capital requirements creates a friendlier issuance environment and regulatory arbitrage versus the EU — supportive for stablecoin growth and market activity.
